data.name: Domitia
data.gender_notes: Domitia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient Rome, a woman of high rank and status. Derived from the Roman family name 'Domitius'. The name Domitia carries the meaning “Lady, mistress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Domitia usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, mistress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Domitia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady, mistress.”

in_hebrew.name: דומיטיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דומיטיה היא שם נשמה שצורף לאל, רצון של עזרה, שמקורה בעזרא. בחברה היהודית, השם דומיטיה היה קשורה למטרה נשית המבקשת לקבל שם-פרט. במסורת יהודית, השם הקדוש דומיטיה מזוהה עם רצון-עזרה, ובדרך-כלל היא ניתנה לנשים בכלא.

in_greek.name: Δωμῖτια
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Δωμῖτια είναι ένα όνομα ψυχής που προστίθεται στον Θεό, θέλημα της βοήθειας, που προέρχεται από τον Εζρα. Στη ελληνική κοινωνία, το όνομα Δωμῖτια συνδέεται με τη δουλεία, που ήταν μια τεράστια πηγή πλούτου για τους Ρωμαίους. Στην πρώιμη εκκλησία, το όνομα Δωμῖτια ήταν ένα από τα πιο σημαντικά ονόματα για τις γυναίκες, καθώς συμβόλιζε τη βοήθεια και τη στήριξη.

in_latin.name: Domitia
in_latin.long_meaning: Domitia est nomen animi quod additur Deo, voluntas assistendi, quae ex Ezra provenit. In cultura Romana, nomen Domitia era connotata ad servitutem, quae erat magna fons divitiarum pro Romanis. In Ecclesia prima, nomen Domitia erat unum ex nominibus gravissimis pro feminis, cum significaret assistentiam et sustentationem.

in_english.name: Domitia
in_english.meaning: benevolent soul, will of assistance, kind heart, gentle spirit
in_english.long_meaning: Domitia is a Christian name that originates from the Hebrew root 'Ezra' meaning assistant or helper. In Christian tradition, the name Domitia symbolizes the will of God's assistance and aid. It was a popular name in the early Christian church, particularly for women, as it signified their role as helpers and caregivers. Domitia is also associated with the virtue of kindness and gentleness, making it a popular choice for parents seeking a name that reflects these qualities.
